added_targets.material: Authenticated Cichorium intybus market taproots; isolated inulin characterised
added_targets.preparation: Taproots dehydrated at 40°C, followed by laboratory extraction; qualitative source, not a household preparation protocol

evidence.statement: Primary isolation from chicory taproot identified beta-(2,1) fructan by FTIR and reported extracted inulin degree of polymerisation 26.

added_targets.limitations: Extraction/product characterisation, not a fresh-food serving assay or efficacy study. No root quantity, retention during cooking, or response equivalent to purified inulin inferred.

added_targets.material: Helianthus tuberosus tubers sampled at defined maturity and storage conditions
added_targets.preparation: Harvest maturity and storage-specific laboratory analysis; cooked products not tested

evidence.statement: Primary tuber profiling reported high-polymerisation inulin, including a DP-above-30 fraction; storage altered the chain-length distribution.

added_targets.limitations: Variety, maturity, storage and chain length limit generalisation. No cooked-food quantity, universal microbial response, butyrate yield or mucus benefit inferred.
